title: Employability Services Procured Service Arrangement - Phase 4
description: The Council is seeking to appoint service providers to the Employability Procured Service Arrangement (PSA). This is a bespoke arrangement/flexible framework which has been developed primarily for Employability Services but can be accessed by all services within the Council. The PSA will be procured using the âlight touchâ procedure set out in Regulations 74 -76 of the Public Contracts (Scotland) Regulations 2015 (âthe 2015 Regulationsâ). This allows the Council to carry out a selection process which adopts the principles of equal treatment, non-discrimination and transparency and complies with procurement best practice without requiring the use of the traditional open or restricted procedure set out in the 2015 Regulations. The PSA has a broad scope of service delivery with the opportunity for many providers to be appointed. There is no limit on the number of providers who can be appointed to any of the lots under the PSA. The PSA remains open for its lifetime which allows for new providers to be added over its term, at regular intervals which will be advised by the Council. Applicants to the PSA will be evaluated in âPhasesâ, based on the closing date for each Phase. Following the closing of each Phase, the PSA will re-open for new applications for the next Phase.

title: CHL NBC VE 4754 Pathologie mit Kühlzellen
description: Das Klinikum Centre Hospitalier de Luxembourg beabsichtigt im Zuge des Neubaus einige Pathologieeinrichtung gemäß dem Vergabeverfahren „Buch II Offenes Verfahren (Loi, Art. 63 und 65)" zu beschaffen. Bestandteil der Ausschreibung ist die Lieferung und Montage von - 1 Leichenkühlzellenanlage mit Einzelfächern für 21 Verstorbenen (davon 3 Plätze adipöse) - 1 Leichenkühlzellenanlage für 1 radioaktive Verstorbenen - 18 Leichenmulde Standardgröße - 3 Leichenmulde Adipositas-Größe - 1 Leichenmulde Standardgröße für radioaktive Verstorbene - 1 Wasch- und Seziertisch fahrbar mit Schnittstelle Andockstation - 1 Andocksäule für fahrbaren Seziertisch - 1 Seziertisch, fahrbar für die Entnahme der Hornhäute - 1 Scherenwagen für Sargtransport - 3 Hydraulischer Leichenmulden-Hubwagen für Standardgröße und adipöse Verstorbene - 1 Katafalkrahmen, fahrbar, mit Kühlung inkl. Behang und Mulde - 1 Gefriertruhe für Körperteile mit Temperaturüberwachung - 2 Standleuchter (Elektrokerzen) Die Lieferung und Montage der Bestandteile soll nach dem folgenden Prioritäten-Schema getrennt ablaufen: Montage Unterkonstruktionen, Montage Leichenkühlzellanlagen, Lieferung Zubehör unmittelbar vor Inbetriebnahme (Diebstahlprävention). 1 Haupt- und 1 Nachbesserungstermin sind mit dem Angebotspreis abgegolten, wobei die Teilleistungen gemäß Terminplan gestaffelt einzutakten und mit der örtlichen Bauleitung/Fachbauleitung abzustimmen sind. Die gesetzliche Verjährungsfrist der Gewährleistungsansprüche beginnt mit der Abnahme der Leistung. Der Tag der Abnahme (komplette Montage inklusive Mängelbeseitigungen) ist der Gewährleistungsbeginn. Folgende Leistungen sind neben den gerätebezogenen Leistungen anzubieten und zu kalkulieren: - Bei der Kollisionsprüfung durch den koordinierenden Architekten (4Bund) ist durch den Auftragnehmer (AN) mitzuwirken. Die Montagepläne sind bei Erfordernis anzupassen. - Für Organisationsbesprechungen - auch teil- und abschnittsweise - hat der AN einen mit der Anlage in allen Teilen technisch und betrieblich vertrauten, sachkundigen Mitarbeiter beizustellen. - Weitere Leitungen gemäß den zusätzlichen technischen Vorbemerkungen der Medizintechnik. Eignungskriterien gemäß allgemeinen und besonderen Vertragsbedingungen, Punkt 1.10 / Punkt 2.10 Für die Lieferungen und Montagen der Geräte sind folgende Termine maßgebend: Möglicher Beginn Einbau: 24.09.2027 Spätester Abschluss Montagen: 29.03.2029 (Innenausbau + Technik gem. Generalablaufplan_V5) Unter Berücksichtigung des Starttermins ist ein Montageterminplan vorzulegen und ggf. an Vorgaben des Architekten (4Bund) anzupassen. Die jeweils für die Einbringung und Montage benötigten Zeiten sind pro Gerät zu hinterlegen.

title: CI31 - Excavation et construction de la structure auxiliaire SA6
PIGA Float Assembly Repair Program
description: Login at https://piee.eb.mil and search for 'FA821426RB002' to obtain more details.* Documents related to this procurment are only available through PIEE. 1. Executive Summary: Background & Objective The U.S. Air Force has a critical requirement to support the Minuteman III (MMIII) Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) by maintaining the operational readiness of the Missile Guidance Set (MGS) to meet warfighter requirements. Specifically, this effort supports the repair line for the Pendulous Integrated Gyroscopic Accelerometer (PIGA) Float Assembly. The PIGA Float is a critical and precise sub-assembly that serves as the heart of the PIGA instrument, enabling it to measure missile acceleration. Each MGS contains three separate PIGA instruments (each housing a PIGA Float). Without this critical component, the ICBM would cease to function properly. The PIGA Float repair effort is a continuous operation necessary to avoid mission degradation. Quality control and precision engineering are paramount due to the strategic importance of the MMIII weapon system. The contractor must maintain stringent quality assurance protocols to guarantee that each repaired PIGA Float meets the rigorous military specifications. 2. Scope of Work The contractor shall provide the necessary personnel, facilities, and expertise to support the PIGA Float Assembly repair line. The primary scope includes: Repair Operations - The re-manufacture, rebuild, and repair of PIGA Float Assemblies. Volume / Throughput - The repair of 96 PIGA Floats per year. Government Furnished Equipment (GFE) - The repair and/or replacement of GFE as required to support continuous operation of the PIGA Float repair line 3. Contract Structure & Period of Performance The Government anticipates awarding an Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract utilizing a mix of Cost-Plus-Fixed-Fee (CPFF) and Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) pricing arrangements. Contract Duration - 5-Year IDIQ Anticipated Ordering Period - 1 November 2026 � 31 October 2031 Task Order Structure - Annual issuance of new, two-year non-severable Task Orders 4. Acquisition Authority & Strategy In accordance with Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Subpart 5.1, this solicitation is an intended sole-source procurement. The Government will solicit and negotiate with only one source: Honeywell Aerospace (CAGE: 09128). This action is taken under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by RFO 6.103-1. Market research�including Sources Sought Synopsis FA821425CBPIGA (posted 29 May 2025)�concluded that Honeywell Aerospace is the only responsible source capable of fulfilling the Government�s requirement without causing unacceptable delays to the MMIII weapon system mission. Note: While this is not a request for competitive proposals, information received from other responsible sources identifying their interest and capability will be considered solely to determine whether to conduct a competitive procurement in the future, at the Government�s discretion. 5. Proposal Submission Instructions All proposals submitted in response to this solicitation must be submitted electronically through the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) Solicitation Module. No other methods of proposal submission (e.g., email, hard copy, DoD SAFE) will be accepted. Offerors must be registered in PIEE and have the appropriate roles activated to submit proposals via the Solicitation module prior to the proposal due date. Cost & Pricing Data: The Government requests that ProPricer models (version v9.5.105.2) be submitted in conjunction with all Certified Cost and Pricing Data. Mandatory Pricing Rubric: Submission of the attached Pricing Rubric is a mandatory requirement. Proposals submitted without a completed Pricing Rubric will be automatically rejected by the PIEE solicitation module and will not be considered for evaluation. Submission Cutoff: Proposals will not be accepted after the solicitation closes. Timely submission is the sole responsibility of the offeror, and late proposals will not be evaluated unless otherwise stated under RFO guidelines.

title: Weapons Shipping Harness Refurbishment Blanket Purchase Agreement
description: This is a limited sources combined synopsis/solicitation for services prepared in accordance with simplified acquisition procedures found in the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Revolutionary Far Overhaul (RFO) Subpart 13.2, effective 1 February 2026, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation/notice; further written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation Number N6278927Q0001 is issued as a Request for Quotes (RFQ). The solicitation and incorporated provisions and clauses are in effect through the most current Federal Acquisition Circular (FAC) 2026-01 with an effective date of 13 March 2026. The Product and Service Code (PSC) is J019. The North American Industry Classification (NAICS) code is 336419. Supervisor of Shipbuilding Conversion and Repair, Groton CT (SSGR) intends to enter into a multiple award Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA), for a period of 5 years. The vendor shall refurbish weapon Shipping Harnesses in accordance with the attached specification. The Period of Performance shall be 27 January 2027 to 26 January 2032. Each BPA will have up to a five (5) year ordering period with a ceiling of up to $500,000. The BPA Call Limit will be $100,000. The ceiling of each agreement can be increased or decreased at any time by the Contracting Officer via bilateral modification to meet current and future requirements. Funding is not assigned to the BPA. The Government will only be obligated to the extent of calls placed against an awarded BPA. Each BPA call will be competed among the agreement holders as requirements arise. A call will then be placed based on the quote that is most advantageous to the Government. Offerors must provide a description of their property management system per FAR 45.201(c)(4) or confirmation of a property management system that has been reviewed and approved per DFARS 242.302 and meets the requirements of FAR 52.245-1(f). Offerors shall submit a pricing schedule that covers each year of the Period of Performance as follows: Fiscal Year Service Unit Unit Price Amount 2027 U-SSN 688 Weapon Shipping Harness Refurb 1 JOB $XX.XX $XX.XX 2028 U-SSN 688 Weapon Shipping Harness Refurb 1 JOB $XX.XX $XX.XX 2029 U-SSN 688 Weapon Shipping Harness Refurb 1 JOB $XX.XX $XX.XX 2030 U-SSN 688 Weapon Shipping Harness Refurb 1 JOB $XX.XX $XX.XX 2031 U-SSN 688 Weapon Shipping Harness Refurb 1 JOB $XX.XX $XX.XX Quotations are due prior to 4:00PM EST, 3 December 2026. Late submissions will not be accepted. Offers should be submitted via electronic commerce. The electronic address for receipt of offers is: kyle.r.berg3.civ@us.navy.mil and stephanie.l.neale.civ@us.navy.mil. Offerors should identify the RFQ number in the Subject Line of the email. Offerors are advised to submit electronic documents early and confirm successful transmission/receipt. The System for Award Management (SAM) is a Government maintained database of companies wanting to do business with the Government. A firm must register and maintain an active SAM registration in order to receive a federal award. Register at: https://sam.gov/SAM/pages/public/index.js EVALUATION FACTORS FOR AWARD: The Government intends to enter into a multiple award Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA), for a period of 5 years. Each BPA call will be competed among the agreement holders as requirements arise. The Government will make award(s) to the offeror(s) that represent the best value to the Government based on the following factors, in order: -Technical Qualifications/Ability to meet schedule -Past Performance -Price The Government intends to evaluate proposals and award a contract without discussions with offerors. However, the Government reserves the right to conduct discussions if later determined by the Contracting Officer to be necessary. The Government reserves the right to award one line, all line items, or any combination thereof. If multiple line items are awarded, cost/prices for each line item will be totaled and the award amount will be based on that total. See Section M of the solicitation for additional details.

TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: Clathrate Therapeutics Platform
description: This technology from scientists at Los Alamos National Laboratory represents a novel platform for improving the safety and effectiveness of therapeutic gas-based treatments by enabling controlled, localized delivery at the site of disease. By addressing longstanding challenges associated with systemic exposure and dosing precision, the platform enhances the clinical viability of gas therapies across high-value markets such as oncology, cardiovascular care, and regenerative medicine. In addition, the inclusion of a complementary predictive modeling capability supports treatment optimization and development efficiency, reducing technical risk and accelerating translation. Together, these capabilities position the technology as a differentiated and scalable solution that can unlock new commercial opportunities in areas where gas-based therapeutics have shown promise but faced delivery limitations. The Opportunity: Therapeutic gases have demonstrated meaningful biological effects across oncology, cardiovascular disease, neuroprotection and regenerative medicine, yet their clinical adoption has been limited by a fundamental challenge: safe, controlled and localized delivery. Existing approaches often result in rapid release, systemic exposure or narrow therapeutic windows, creating safety, regulatory and development barriers. The Clathrate Therapeutics Platform addresses this unmet need by positioning gas-based therapies as programmable, targetable and commercially viable treatment modalities. By enabling more precise control over where and how therapeutic gases are delivered, the platform has the potential to unlock new product categories, enhance combination treatment strategies and accelerate translation of gas-based therapeutics into high-value clinical markets. How it Works: The Clathrate Therapeutics Platform uses a proprietary, controlled-release system designed to localize therapeutic gases at the intended treatment site rather than allowing them to disperse systemically. This technology temporarily stabilizes the gas within a biocompatible structure that gradually releases it under physiological conditions, enabling sustained and targeted exposure. This controlled release approach is designed to support therapeutic concentrations where needed while limiting circulating levels elsewhere in the body. An integrated computational modeling capability further supports optimization of dosing profiles and treatment parameters, helping guide development decisions prior to in vivo studies. Key Advantages: Localized delivery: Targets therapeutic gases to the intended site while minimizing systemic exposure. Controlled release: Designed for sustained, tunable dosing under physiological conditions. Improved safety margin: Aims to separate therapeutic effect from toxicity risk. Platform versatility: Applicable across oncology, cardiovascular, neurological and regenerative indications. Development optimization: Supported by predictive modeling to guide dose and design decisions. Partnership-ready architecture: Suitable for integration with drug-device combinations and existing treatment modalities. Market Applications: Oncology Therapeutics Industry Cardiovascular and Vascular Medicine Industry Neurology and Neurodegenerative Disease Sector Regenerative Medicine and Tissue Engineering Industry Medical Device and Drug-Device Combination Companies Biotechnology and Specialty Pharma Companies Computational Drug Development and Modeling Firms Development Status: TRL 2 US patent pending LA-UR-26-22810 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. title: TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: Heat Pipe Reactor Wick and Fill Platform
description: This technology platform from Los Alamos National Laboratory enables more reliable high-temperature heat pipe reactors by improving the way critical wick structures are manufactured and how heat pipe arrays are filled, sealed, and checked for quality. A stronger wick gives the system the capillary action needed to move liquid metal through the pipe under demanding thermal conditions, while the fill platform helps prepare clean, repeatable assemblies that are better suited for reactor-grade use. For organizations working in nuclear, space, or other high-heat environments, the Heat Pipe Reactor Wick and Fill Platform offers a more practical route to building durable thermal hardware with fewer manufacturing bottlenecks. How it Works The Heat Pipe Reactor Wick and Fill Platform begins with wick fabrication, where a fine mesh or similar material is shaped around a mandrel and compressed so the layers can be bonded into a strong porous tube. Depending on the version, the wick can be formed by drawing, hydroforming, or other controlled shaping methods before diffusion bonding locks the structure in place. After bonding, the temporary mandrel and sheath are removed by etching, leaving a porous wick with the pore structure and geometry needed for high-temperature alkali metal heat pipes. The fill process is designed to load, seal, and inspect heat pipe arrays under controlled atmosphere conditions, often using vacuum or inert gas environments. That workflow can be automated with precision metering, controlled handling, and laser welding, which helps improve repeatability and reduce contamination risk. Quality control can be built into both the wick and fill steps through inspection of the porous structure, leak testing, fill verification, and process monitoring, all of which support more consistent reactor-scale production. Technical Description The wick fabrication methods focus on producing a porous annular structure with the strength and capillary performance required for high-temperature heat pipe reactors. In one approach, mesh layers are wrapped around an etchable mandrel, compressed inside a sheath, and diffusion bonded so the layers fuse into a stable structure. After bonding, the mandrel and sheath are removed chemically, leaving a porous tube that functions as the wick. Related versions use hydroforming or modular splicing to support curved, variable or larger-format wick geometries that are difficult to make with conventional methods. A second technical element is the fill, seal and inspection platform for heat pipe arrays. The Heat Pipe Reactor Wick and Fill Platform is intended to meter alkali-metal working fluid into multiple heat pipes under vacuum or inert conditions, then seal the assemblies with controlled welding or bonding steps. Built-in inspection can confirm seal integrity, working-fluid fill quality and process repeatability. The combination of automated handling and quality control makes the technology more suitable for scale-up, especially where contamination control and consistent output are essential. Advantages Supports high-temperature heat transport in demanding environments Improves manufacturability of complex wick structures Helps increase reliability and consistency in heat pipe production Enables more scalable filling, sealing and inspection of heat pipe arrays Better suited for long-life, high-purity alkali-metal systems Strong fit for compact, passive thermal management applications Market Applications Nuclear Energy (microreactors, reactor heat transport, thermal management systems) Space (space reactors, power conversion, radiator-side heat rejection) Aerospace (high-reliability thermal control, compact heat transport) Defense (remote power systems, mission-critical thermal hardware) Advanced Manufacturing (specialized heat pipe production tools and processes) Industrial Energy Systems (high-temperature heat recovery and thermal transport) In addition to patent licensing, Los Alamos may loan a full-scale prototype, modular alkali metal heat-pipe fill system hardware allowing the fill and seal of individual or large arrays of alkali metal heat pipes. title: Spain – Buildings of particular historical or architectural interest – Obras de rehabilitación del Almacén de Abastos de Ceuta como Archivo General y Museo Militar
description: El Almacén de Abastos forma parte del conjunto histórico de fortificaciones de la Almina, declarado BIC en la categoría de Monumento. Constituye uno de los restos que quedan de la fortificación de la Almina y su función fue servir de almacenaje y logística al conjunto del enclave. El Almacén de Abastos se dispone en el extremo oriental del sector septentrional del Conjunto de la Almina. La línea amurallada de este frente discurriría justo al norte de esta construcción, situándose a su altura la batería de Abastos. El fin del proyecto consiste en la rehabilitación y adecuación del histórico Almacén de Abastos de Ceuta para incorporar dos nuevos equipamientos culturales: el Museo Militar en la planta baja y el Archivo General de la Ciudad en la planta primera. La intervención busca conservar y poner en valor la arquitectura existente, garantizando al mismo tiempo las necesidades funcionales y ambientales de ambos usos. En la planta baja, el Museo Militar se organiza en áreas públicas y de trabajo. Se incluyen también zonas de acogida, descanso y servicios, y espacios internos para almacenamiento de piezas y gestión administrativa. En la planta primera, el Archivo General se divide en área pública, depósitos y zona de trabajo. Los depósitos deberán albergar un volumen documental muy amplio con recorridos visitables. El área de trabajo incorpora espacios de recepción y limpieza de documentos, catalogación, conservación y reprografía, junto con puestos de atención al ciudadano y despachos. El proyecto proporciona así una nueva vida cultural al edificio, combinando funcionalidad contemporánea, preservación patrimonial y servicio público. El ámbito total de intervención comprende 3.079 m2 construidos.

title: Spain – Roadworks – Nuevos accesos a la ampliación sur del puerto de Barcelona. Fase 2A. Clave de expediente: OB-GP-P-0870/2020
description: El objeto de la presente licitación es la contratación de la obra Nuevos accesos a la ampliación sur del Puerto de Barcelona. Fase 2A que consiste en la construcción de un nuevo nudo viario que permita la adecuada articulación entre la red viaria estructurante del puerto de Barcelona y la nueva autovía de acceso al puerto. Este nudo viario, a desarrollar sobre la antigua desembocadura del rio Llobregat, constituirá la infraestructura viaria más importante del puerto y deberá ser compatible con el importante nudo ferroviario a desarrollar en el antiguo cauce. Este enlace viario consistirá en una gran rotonda elevada con tres ramales, cuyos condicionantes vienen impuestos por la infraestructura ferroviaria a desarrollar en ese mismo emplazamiento. Este enlace consta de una conexión con la nueva autovía, otra conexión con la ampliación Sur y una tercera conexión que permitirá el acceso a las instalaciones portuarias situadas al norte de la antigua desembocadura. El enlace dispondrá también de 3 carriles directos. También tiene como objeto facilitar el futuro cruce bajo la infraestructura ferroviaria de redes de servicios para lo cual se ha proyectado una galería de servicios. Asimismo, incluye una conexión de carácter provisional con la infraestructura viaria situada al norte. La conexión provisional, incluida en esta actuación, permite la conexión con la calle 4. Quedará pendiente para desarrollar en el futuro una conexión definitiva, que no es objeto de este contrato. Esa conexión definitiva incluirá un viaducto que permitirá la conexión directa del nuevo enlace con la calle 3 del puerto. La ejecución de esa conexión definitiva con la zona norte (Proyecto de Nuevos Access a la Ampliación Sur. Fase 2B) será ejecutada posteriormente a la construcción del nuevo atraque 35B cuya ejecución condiciona los espacios necesarios para el desarrollo del futuro viaducto. La obra deberá ejecutarse de conformidad con el Proyecto publicado, que incluye en su contenido el Pliego de Prescripciones Técnicas.

Rugged Tablet Das Departement IT (DIT) beschafft, verwaltet und managed diese zentral über die EMM Lösung «Workspace ONE UEM» von Omnissa. Weiterer wichtiger, zentraler Baustein bezüglich Sicherheit und Betrieb ist zudem auch die «Samsung Knox»-Plattform. Neben einem normalen laufenden Lifecycle und Wachstum stehen umfangreichere Geräteerneuerung und -erweiterungen an. Zudem wird eine Standardisierung des Portfolios auf Android-basierten Smartphones und Tablets angestrebt. Mit der vorliegende Ausschreibung sollen die vertraglichen Grundlagen für die zukünftigen Beschaffungen ab dem 1. Januar 2027 von Samsung-Mobilgeräten sowie definierter Betriebsleistungen geschaffen werden. Ziel ist ein langfristig verfügbares, zentral verwaltbares und sicher betreibbares Geräteportfolio mit klaren Service-, Lifecycle- und Nachhaltigkeitsleistungen. Die Geräte müssen in die bestehende Enterprise-Mobility-Infrastruktur auf Basis Omnissa Workspace ONE UEM und Samsung Knox integriert werden können. Für die Ausschreibung wurde seitens Auftraggeber entsprechende Samsung-Gerätemodelle festgelegt. Für Folgebestellung gilt ein entsprechendes allfälliges Nachfolgemodell. Bei Abkündigung eines Modells gelten die Bestimmungen zu Nachfolgemodellen gemäss Lastenheft Kapitel 5.3.3. Die Zusammenarbeit wird in einem Rahmenvertrag (Beschaffungen) sowie einem Servicevertrag (Betriebsleistungen) jeweils mit einer fünfjährigen Laufzeit geregelt, welche zwei Mal für jeweils zwei Jahre optional verlängert werden kann. Die effektiven Beschaffungen erfolgen während der Vertragslaufzeit bedarfsorientiert durch HOCH Health Ostschweiz. Für die Planung der Ersatz- und Neubeschaffungen bilden insbesondere der Lifecycle Ersatz (interner Lifecycle mind. 5 Jahre), die Mittelfristplanung sowie die definierten End-of-Support-(EOS)Zeitpunkte der Geräte eine wesentliche Grundlage. Grundsätzlich erfolgen die Beschaffungen in 3-4 grösseren Sammelbestellungen pro Jahr. Es soll zudem möglich sein, Einzelbeschaffungen von abweichenden Spezialausführungen über den Rahmenvertrag abzuwickeln. Bestehende Geräte werden bis zur bedarfsorientierten Ersatzbeschaffung weiterbetrieben. Die neue Anbieterin muss keine Betriebs-, Support- oder Reparaturleistungen für Geräte übernehmen, welche nicht durch sie geliefert wurden. Defekte Bestandsgeräte werden innerhalb der Garantielaufzeit über die bisherigen Prozesse abgewickelt; ausserhalb der Garantie erfolgt grundsätzlich ein Ersatz durch neue Geräte. Zusammenstellung Beschaffungsgegenstand . Rahmenvertrag für Kauf von Samsung Mobilgeräten gemäss Lastenheft Kapitel 7 inkl. mind. 2 Jahre Garantie und 5 Jahre Ersatzteil-Verfügbarkeit. title: Romania – Feasibility study, advisory service, analysis – ELABORARE STUDIU DE FEZABILITATE PRIVIND OBIECTIVUL DE INVESTITII „VARIANTA DE OCOLIRE A ORASULUI HARLAU, JUDETUL IASI”
description: Contractul vizează elaborarea Studiului de Fezabilitate obiectivului de investiții „VARIANTA DE OCOLIRE A ORAȘULUI HÂRLAU, JUDEȚUL IAȘI”, în județul Iași. Proiectul este strategic pentru decongestionarea traficului de pe DN 28B. Propunerea de traseu pentru Varianta de Ocolire Hârlău începe la intersecția cu DN28B – zona de sud a Orașului Hârlău și se termină la intersecția cu DN28B zona de nord a Orașului Hârlău cu o direcție orientată nord-est. Profilul transversal al aliniamentului se caracterizează printr-o lățime a părții carosabile de 12 m cu două benzi, câte o bandă pe sens (fiecare cu o lățime de 3.5 m). Intersecțiile cu infrastructura rutieră existentă se vor realiza prin sensuri giratorii. Obiectivul de investiții va fi proiectat și executat la un nivel tehnic și calitativ corespunzător unei infrastructuri rutiere moderne, respectând exigențele esențiale stabilite prin legislația în vigoare și normativele tehnice specifice drumurilor. Structuri rutiere și lucrările de artă vor fi dimensionate conform traficului estimat (straturi de fundație stabilizate, mixturi asfaltice adecvate pentru trafic greu, etc.), amenajarea elementelor de captare și evacuare a apelor pluviale, a taluzurilor și a zonelor conexe drumului. Se va asigura iluminatul public și semnalizare completă. Elementele componente ale viitorului contract: 1. Proiectare: • Elaborare Studiu de fezabilitate; • Asistenta tehnică acordată Beneficiarului pentru procedura de atribuire a contractelor de proiectare și execuție lucrări În conformitate cu prevederile art. 160 din Legea nr. 98/2016, termenele limită sunt stabilite după cum urmează: Operatorii economici pot solicita informații suplimentare/clarificari considerate necesare, privind documentația de atribuire cu cel târziu 25 de zile înainte de data limită pentru depunerea ofertelor, iar Autoritatea Contractanta va răspunde în mod consolidat tuturor solicitărilor primite într-un singur termen limită, stabilit cu 12 zile înainte de data limită de depunere a ofertelor. Aceste termene au fost corelate pentru a asigura operatorilor economici timpul necesar analizei documentației și adaptării ofertelor în conformitate cu precizările furnizate de Autoritatea Contractantă.

title: Samsung Mobile Devices
description:
Chez HOCH Health Ostschweiz, des appareils mobiles tels que des smartphones ou des tablettes sont utilisés dans divers processus. Actuellement, il s'agit d'appareils Android (Samsung) ainsi que iOS (Apple). Types d'appareils définis :

. Business Smartphone

. PUT-Tablet normal (Bedside)

. PUT-Tablet Prestige (Bedside)

. Business Tablet

. Rugged Tablet


Le département informatique (DIT) acquiert, administre et gère ces appareils de manière centralisée via la solution EMM « Workspace ONE UEM » d'Omnissa. Un autre élément central et important pour la sécurité et l'exploitation est la plateforme «Samsung Knox».


En plus du cycle de vie normal et de la croissance courante, des renouvellements et des extensions d'envergure du parc d'appareils sont programmés. De plus, une standardisation du portefeuille vers des smartphones et des tablettes basés sur Android est recherchée.


Le présent appel d'offres vise à créer les bases contractuelles pour les futures acquisitions d'appareils mobiles Samsung ainsi que de prestations d'exploitation définies, et ce à compter du 1er janvier 2027. L'objectif est de disposer d'un portefeuille d'appareils disponibles à long terme, gérables de manière centralisée et exploitables en toute sécurité, assorti de prestations claires en matière de service, de cycle de vie et de durabilité.

Les appareils doivent pouvoir s'intégrer dans l'infrastructure de mobilité d'entreprise existante, basée sur Omnissa Workspace ONE UEM et Samsung Knox.


Pour cet appel d'offres, l'adjudicateur a défini des modèles d'appareils Samsung correspondants. Pour les commandes ultérieures, un éventuel modèle successeur s'appliquera. En cas de fin de commercialisation d'un modèle, les dispositions relatives aux modèles successeurs selon le chapitre 5.3.3 du cahier des charges s'appliquent.


La collaboration est régie par un contrat-cadre (acquisitions) ainsi que par un contrat de service (prestations d'exploitation), chacun d'une durée de cinq ans, qui peut être prolongé en option deux fois pour une durée de deux ans à chaque fois.


Les acquisitions effectives seront réalisées pendant la durée du contrat par HOCH Health Ostschweiz en fonction des besoins. Pour la planification des remplacements et des nouvelles acquisitions, le cycle de vie de remplacement (cycle de vie interne d'au moins 5 ans), la planification à moyen terme ainsi que les dates de fin de support (EOS) définies pour les appareils constituent une base essentielle. En principe, les acquisitions se font sous la forme de 3 à 4 commandes groupées importantes par an. Il doit également être possible de traiter des acquisitions individuelles de versions spéciales divergentes via le contrat-cadre.


Les appareils existants continueront à être exploités jusqu'à leur remplacement en fonction des besoins. Le nouveau fournisseur n'est pas tenu de reprendre des prestations d'exploitation, de support ou de réparation pour des appareils qui n'ont pas été livrés par ses soins. Les appareils défectueux du parc existant seront traités via les processus actuels pendant la période de garantie ; en dehors de la garantie, ils seront en principe remplacés par de nouveaux appareils.


Composition de l'objet de l'acquisition

. Contrat-cadre pour l'achat d'appareils mobiles Samsung conformément au chapitre 7 du cahier des charges, comprenant au moins 2 ans de garantie et 5 ans de disponibilité des pièces de rechange. Volume quantitatif pour 5 ans (planifié) :

. 5'000 Business Smartphone (Samsung Galaxy XCover 7 Enterprise Edition)

. 1'200  PUT-Tablet normal (Samsung Galaxy Tab A11

. 200     PUT-Tablet Prestige (Samsung Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra)

. 200     Business Tablet (Samsung Galaxy Tab S11)

. 200     Rugged Tablet (Samsung Galaxy Tab Active 5 Pro)

. Prestations d'exploitation conformément au chapitre 5.3 du cahier des charges.

. Prestations uniques lors de l'achat de matériel conformément au chapitre 5.3.2 du cahier des charges.


À la conclusion du contrat, les appareils et quantités suivants devraient être commandés :

. 360x PUT-Tablet normal (Samsung Galaxy Tab A11)

. 100x PUT-Tablet Prestige (Samsung Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra)

. 150x Rugged Tablet (Samsung Galaxy Tab Active 5 Pro)

Cette première commande doit être effectuée aux conditions proposées dans l'offre.

title: Totalentreprise Øvergården bofellesskap
description: Frøya kommune ønsker å etablere 10 nye omsorgsboliger for personer med funksjonsnedsettelser sørvest for Frøya kommunehus på Sistranda. Eksisterende bebyggelse ble etablert i 1991 som Øvergården bofellesskap i forbindelse med den nasjonale HVPU-reformen. Bygget oppfyller ikke dagens krav og behov. Oppdraget omfatter riving av eksisterende bygningsmasse og bygging av et nytt Øvergårdenbofellesskap, et omsorgssenter med 10 omsorgsboliger og fellesarealer.Utflytting av eksisterende bygningsmasse er planlagt feb/ mar 2027, og det forventes innflytting i nytt bygg høsten 2028.Prosjektet gjennomføres som totalentreprise etter NS 8407. Totalentreprenøren har det samlede ansvaret for prosjektering, koordinering, utførelse, testing, idriftsettelse, prøvedrift og ferdigstillelse av alle arbeider som er nødvendige for å levere et komplett og funksjonsdyktig bygg i henhold til kontraktens krav.Totalentreprenøren skal selv vurdere og innarbeide alle ytelser, leveranser og arbeider som er nødvendige for å oppfylle prosjektets funksjons- og myndighetskrav, også der disse ikke er uttrykkelig beskrevet i konkurransegrunnlaget. Entreprenøren har ansvar for koordinering av samtlige rådgivere, leverandører og underentreprenører.Byggherren angir prosjektets overordnede mål, funksjonskrav og kvalitetskrav, mens valg av tekniske løsninger og detaljutforming inngår i totalentreprenørens ansvar. Prosjektet skal overleveres komplett, ferdig testet og dokumentert med nødvendig FDV-dokumentasjon. 6mnd prøvedrift inngår i totalentreprisen.

title: Germany – Railway station construction work – Modernisierung VST Hagen Hbf - VP 01.3 - Neubau Bahnsteige 1&5, Ausbau PU
description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung sind die Bauleistungen zur Modernisierung des Hauptbahnhofs Hagen im Rahmen des Projekts „VP 01.3 – Neubau der Bahnsteige 1 und 5 sowie Ausbau der Personenunterführung“. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst im Wesentlichen die Baustelleneinrichtung und Baulogistik unter Eisenbahnbetrieb, den Rückbau vorhandener Bahnsteig-, Dach-, Treppen-, Aufzugs- und Tunnelanlagen einschließlich Entsorgung der anfallenden Materialien, Erd-, Tiefbau- und Entwässerungsarbeiten, Kabeltiefbauarbeiten, den Neubau der Bahnsteigkanten und Bahnsteigflächen, die Errichtung von Bahnsteigdächern sowie Ausbau- und Fassadenarbeiten im Bereich der Personenunterführung. Zu den wesentlichen Mengen gehören insbesondere: • Herrichten von Baustellen- und Lagerflächen von insgesamt ca. 2.200 m², • Rückbau von ca. 1.500 m² Bahnsteigbelägen und ca. 532 m Bahnsteigkanten, • Aushub- und Verfüllarbeiten von insgesamt ca. 2.000 m³, • Entsorgung von ca. 1.235 t Bauschutt, ca. 3.190 t Bodenmaterial, ca. 48 t Metallen und ca. 90 t Altholz, • Neubau von ca. 1.068 m Bahnsteigkanten einschließlich Fundamente und Fertigteile, • Herstellung von Entwässerungsanlagen mit insgesamt ca. 715 m Entwässerungsleitungen und 21 Schächten, • Kabeltiefbauarbeiten mit Rohr- und Kabelschutzsystemen von insgesamt mehr als 1.200 m Länge, • Herstellung von ca. 3.250 m² Bahnsteigbefestigungen aus Betonsteinpflaster einschließlich taktiler Leitelemente, • Neubau von Bahnsteigdächern mit einer Gesamtfläche von ca. 825 m², • Herstellung einer Glasfassade mit einer Fläche von ca. 740 m² sowie Ausbauarbeiten in der Personenunterführung mit Bodenbelägen von insgesamt ca. 580 m². Die Leistungen werden unter laufendem Eisenbahnbetrieb und unter Berücksichtigung der hierfür erforderlichen Sicherungs-, Logistik- und Bauphasenmaßnahmen ausgeführt. Bestandteil des Auftrags sind sämtliche hierfür notwendigen Planungs-, Koordinations-, Dokumentations- und Nebenleistungen.

title: Norway – Passenger cars – Dynamic purchasing system (DPS) for leasing and purchasing of new and used vehicles
description: Telemark Innkjøpssamarbeid (TIS) is a joint procurement unit for the municipalities: Kviteseid, Nissedal, Nome, Midt-Telemark, Seljord, Vinje and Tokke. Telemark Innkjøpssamarbeid (TIS) intends to establish a dynamic procurement scheme for the procurement and leasing of new and used passenger cars and goods vans under 3.5 tonnes as well as minibuses with up to 17 seats, both fossil, hybrid, electric, hydrogen, gas, etc. The contracting authority would like the future vehicle fleet to be considerably more climate-friendly and environmentally friendly and therefore focus on purchasing and leasing vehicles that are fossil free as long as such vehicles fulfil decisive transport needs. Increasingly more focus on circular economy means that municipalities will increasingly consider buying or leasing used vehicles rather than new ones, but it is up to each individual municipality how they will handle this. The contracting authority would like a dynamic purchasing system for future procurements of a number of different types of vehicles. The vehicles that will be procured are primarily, but not limited to: *Private car * Multi-purpose vehicle (up to 9 seats) * Goods vans (all types including pick-up) * Minibuses (up to 17 seats) The scheme shall include the following options: *Service agreements * Repairs and the accompanying parts beyond the warranty period * Tyre hotel, tyres and tyre replacement * Loan vehicles/hired cars * Collection and delivery of vehicles in connection with service, repairs etc. * Other accompanying services The tenderer, who would like admission in the scheme, shall also be able to offer a service contract, repairs with the accompanying parts beyond the guarantee period, tyre hotel, tyres, tyre replacement, loan vehicle/hire vehicle, collection/delivery and other associated services. The dynamic purchasing system is divided into seven geographical zones (see the tender documentation). Tenderers can apply for qualification (Stage 1) in one or more geographical zones as long as the qualification requirements are fulfilled. Tenderers are required to have the delivery of vehicles and workshops in the geographical zone for admission to a geographical zone. Only qualified tenderers will have access to published competitions (Stage 2). Tenderers who are qualified will be sent notification in Artifik (to a stated e-mail address) each time the Customer publishes a competition within the geographical zone in which the Tenderer is qualified. Tenderers can then choose to submit a tender in the relevant competition, or choose to abstain. The contracting authority intends to use the geographical zone that is most appropriate for travel time, but can at any time during the contract period, choose which geographical zone the vehicle would like to purchase or lease in.

Netherlands – Garments for biological or chemical protection – Uitrukkleding brandweer
description: De VRH wil een raamovereenkomst met één leverancier afsluiten voor de aanschaf van uitrukkleding brandweer en de daarbij behorende dienstverlening tijdens de periode van samenwerking. Met uitrukkleding wordt bedoeld de broek en jas die de brandweer draagt tijdens een incident, met optioneel de toebehoren. Deze kleding moet daarom minimaal voldoen aan de EN 469:2020 normen, X2, Y2 en Z2. De medewerkers zijn divers in maatvoering en geslacht, de kleding moet voor alle medewerkers passend beschikbaar zijn. De VRH verstrekt per medewerker in de operationele dienst twee persoonlijke pakken. De pakken moeten bescherming geven tijdens brandbestrijding (warmte) maar ook een basis bescherming bieden tegen chemicaliën en invloeden van buitenaf. Draagcomfort, zichtbaarheid en uitstraling zijn van belang. De VRH kiest voor een losse jas en broek met bretels in de goudgele kleur en wil aansluiten op de Huisstijl uitrukkleding brandweer Nederland. De intentie is om alle ongeveer 850 operationele medewerkers van twee nieuwe pakken te voorzien. Gedurende de looptijd zullen bestellingen geplaatst worden voor nieuwe medewerkers, vervanging bij schade, slijtage of andere noodzaak.

title: Pharmaceutical Dispensing Services including the Supply and Delivery of Medicine

- The acceptance of the Relevant Authority’s electronic ordering of medicines processes through both ePMA system integration and by email.

Na publicatie van de selectieleidraad organiseert de gemeente een plenaire (facultatieve) informatiebijeenkomst voor geïnteresseerde marktpartijen. Nadere details en aanmeldvoorwaarden volgen in de Selectieleidraad. De gemeente heeft op dit moment nog geen besluit genomen m.b.t. de publicatie van deze aanbesteding. Naar verwachting zal dat besluit worden genomen op 3 november. De aanbesteding zal dan daarna worden gepubliceerd. Dit betreft slechts een vooraankondiging en dient uitsluitend ter informatie van de markt zodat partijen zich tijdig kunnen voorbereiden. Aan deze vooraankondiging kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. De formele aanbestedingsdocumenten en voorwaarden worden gepubliceerd op Mercell.

Il est donc prévu d’acquérir une nouvelle plateforme de calcul et de communication pour les véhicules sur rails. title: Taidekasarmin muutos ja peruskorjaus, kokonaisurakoitsijan hankinta
description: Taidekasarmin muutos ja peruskorjaus, kokonaisurakoitsijan hankinta Rakennus on valmistunut vuonna 1915, ja se kuuluu Hyrylän kasarmialueen toiseen rakennuskauteen. Kyseessä on yksikerroksinen, massiivitiilirakenteinen rakennus, jossa on ullakko. Rakennuksen omistaa Tuusulan kunta ja se on asemakaavassa suojeltu kulttuurihistoriallisesti ja aluekokonaisuuden kannalta arvokkaana kohteena (sr-24). Rakennus sijaitsee pohjavesialueella. Hanke kattaa rakennuksen peruskorjauksen sekä käyttötarkoituksen muutoksen ravintolaksi. Lisäksi naapuritontille rakennetaan uusi, noin 45 m²:n huoltorakennus, johon tulee ravintolan jätetila. Huoltorakennus toteutetaan poikkeamispäätöksen perusteella ja sen tieltä puretaan nykyinen jätekatos. Huoltoliikenne järjestetään Esikunnanpolun kautta. Kunta tekee urakka-alueen ulkopuolisen varsinaisen katualueen työt. Tilaaja on aiemmin purkanut rakennuksen alapohjan betonirakenteet sekä suurimman osan yläpohjan ei-kantavista rakenteista. Peruskorjauksessa tehdään uudet alapohjarakenteet. Lisäksi sokkeli mantteloidaan teräsbetonilla, kantaviin tiiliseiniin injektoidaan kapillaarikatko ja ensimmäisen kerroksen kattoon asennetaan teräksiset jäykistys- ja vahvistusrakenteet. Osa sisäpuolisista rappauksista poistetaan, ja tiilipinnat puhdistetaan. Julkisivu ja ikkunat kunnostetaan. Ravintolarakennukseen tehdään lisäksi kaksi uutta poistumistieovea, esteetön sisäänkäynti portaineen ja luiskineen, terassi, huoltotaso ja lastauslaituri portaineen ja luiskineen sekä ullakolle johtava kierreporras. Sisätiloihin tehdään ravintolatoiminnan edellyttämät muutokset, kuten valmistuskeittiö ja kylmiöt. Ullakko otetaan osittain käyttöön IV-konehuoneina. Vesikatolle asennetaan uudet IV-konehuoneiden piiput, vesikattovarusteet sekä uudet savunpoisto- ja kattoluukut. Käyttötarkoituksen muutos edellyttää taloteknisten järjestelmien kattavaa uusimista. Rakennustöissä on otettava huomioon haitta-ainekartoitus, kunto- ja rakennetutkimukset sekä museoviranomaisen lausunnot. Ravintolarakennus ja huoltorakennus toteutetaan P1-puhtausluokan mukaisesti. Tarkemmat tekniset ratkaisut on esitetty suunnittelualakohtaisissa työselostuksissa ja erikoissuunnitelmissa. Urakka-alue on asemapiirustuksen mukainen, ja siihen kuuluu myös huoltoliikenne- ja puistoaluetta. Tavoitteena on, että käyttäjä pääsee kalustamaan rakennusta ravintolakäyttöä varten loppuvuodesta 2027 (tarkempi ajankohta tarkentuu myöhemmin).,

title: Ireland – Railway construction works – TII499 Luas Finglas Main Infrastructure Design and Construction Works
description: Luas Finglas is a 4 km extension of the Luas Green Line, delivering a high-capacity light rail connection between Finglas and Dublin city centre to support sustainable transport and urban development. The scheme will serve communities including Charlestown, Finglas Village, Finglas West, St Helena’s, and the Tolka Valley, and will comprise four new stops at St Helena’s, Finglas Village, St Margaret’s Road, and Charlestown. It also includes a 350-space Park and Ride facility near St Margaret’s Road, as well as interchange opportunities with bus services and with mainline rail services at Broombridge. The Luas Finglas Main Infrastructure Design and Construction Works will be delivered under the NEC4 Engineering and Construction Contract (ECC) Option C (Target Cost with Activity Schedule). The scope of this Contract (TII-499) includes, but is not limited to, the design and construction of the following principal elements: 1. Site clearance and demolitions. 2. Track (trackbed and rails). 3. Luas Stops at St Helena’s, Finglas Village, St Margaret’s Road and Charlestown. 4. Broombridge stabling site works. 5. Park and Ride facilities at St Margaret's Road. 6. Royal canal and rail overbridge at Broombridge. 7. Tolka Valley Park Bridge. 8. Fencing, retaining walls, boundary treatments and accommodation work. 9. Utility services realignment, diversion, replacement, and protection. 10. Road realignments and junction modifications. 11. Pedestrian and cycling facilities including cycle storage structures. 12. Road traffic signalling. 13. Landscape and urban realm upgrades. 14. Overhead Catenary System (OCS). 15. Power and Systems infrastructure. 16. Signalling, controls and other rail systems. 17. Working in live traffic environment on the busiest radial corridors in the greater Dublin area including property and business frontage reconfiguration. 18. Heritage / archaeology mitigation works. 19. Installation of stop furniture. 20. Installation of Validators and Ticket Vending Machines. 21. Other Ancillary works. The successful Contractor will also be responsible for: • Overall systems integration. • Interfacing and co-ordinating with other works packages to facilitate completion of works. • Interfacing and co-ordinating with stakeholders. • Testing and commissioning.

title: HYDROSPHERE, BIOSPHERE, & GEOPHYSICS (HBG) SUPPORT SERVICES II - FINAL REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (FRFP)
description: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), Goddard Space Flight Center (GSFC), hereby invites interested parties to review the Final Request for Proposal (FRFP) for the Hydrosphere, Biosphere, and Geophysics (HBG) Support Services II requirement supporting the Earth Sciences Division (ESD) at NASA/GSFC. The principal purpose of this requirement is to provide science research that conceives, develops, and applies space, field-deployed (i.e. airborne and in situ) and laboratory based technologies and observations to address issues of importance to society. These include but are not limited to water resources, land and ocean ecosystems, global and regional sea level change, changes in the Earth�s cryosphere, gravity field, magnetic field, solid Earth, and the terrestrial reference frame. The Statement of Work, Attachment A, describes the scope of the requirement. This contract is for support of a full range of science and research activities across the breadth of the various Laboratories that make up the HBG sub-division: the Cryospheric Sciences, Ocean Ecology, Hydrological Sciences, Biospheric Sciences, and Geodesy and Geophysics Laboratories. This contract is also for support of science, research and computing activities within the Terrestrial Information Systems Laboratory (TISL), also in the ESD. For the purposes of this document and contract the term HBG will be used to encompass all the Laboratories of the HBG sub-division and the TISL. NASA will conduct this acquisition as a small business set-aside. This competitive acquisition was originally contemplated as a Cost-Plus-Fixed-Fee (CPFF), Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract with the ability to issue CPFF task orders. Following further acquisition planning and assessment of the Government's requirements, the contract structure has been modified. The HBG II Draft Request for Proposal (DRFP) posted on April 8, 2025 was issued as an IDIQ CPFF solicitation. As amended, this competitive acquisition will now result in a HYBRID Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) with the ability to issue Cost Plus Fixed Fee (CPFF) AND Firm- Fixed Price (FFP) task orders. The contract will have an effective ordering period of five years from the contract effective date. Interested offerors are encouraged to review the solicitation and all associated attachments for complete details regarding the requirements and proposal submission instructions. Please see the attached cover letter for additional information.

title: Fuels Management Services at Malmstrom Air Force Base, MT and FE Warren Air Force Base, WY
description: Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Energy is issuing a Request for Proposal (RFP) for fuels operations and management to include bulk storage services, retail service station support, alongside aircraft services, and entire fuels management services at two Government-Owned, Contractor-Operated (GOCO) facilities, Malmstrom Air Force Base (AFB), MT and FE Warren AFB, WY. The Contractor will ensure safe, accurate, and timely handling, quality control, and accountability of all Defense-Wide Working Capital Fund (DWCF)-owned petroleum products under their control. The Contractor will perform required maintenance to ensure facilities, associated systems, vehicles, and equipment remain operational to meet the base mission. The Contractor shall provide sufficient general-purpose vehicles with appropriate capability to meet the contract requirements but not limited to escorting fuel deliveries where required, towing bowsers, transporting personnel, and performing expeditor duties as needed. The Contractor should provide sufficient special purpose vehicles with appropriate capability to meet the contract requirements for aviation and ground product services. The Contractor will comply with environmental protection, safety, and security directives. The Contractor will conduct required training to ensure personnel are fully qualified to perform Performance Work Statements (PWS) tasks. Tasks identified in the PWS are performed by either the Contractor or Agency as specified in Appendix M The Contractor is responsible for staffing, operations, maintenance, safety, security, environmental protection, training, contractor-furnished items, and Contractor Detailed Plans related to the fuel operations at the location. The Contractor shall conduct all necessary fuels operations to support base operations, airshows and special events, deployments, exercises, and contingencies under normal conditions, as well as, during periods of heightened security, inclement weather, or other unique situations. Operations must be safely and efficiently conducted to receive, store, transfer, issue, and account for fuel products with appropriate controls to ensure fuel quality, inventory accuracy, and no environmental impact. The Contractor shall operate and maintain the self-service automated service station facilities, equipment, and systems and ensure sufficient product is available to provide 24 hours a day, seven days a week support of ground fuels. The Contractor shall perform required tasks to ensure fuel is properly accounted for and issued to only authorized users. This procurement will be 100% restricted to Service Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) participation. Firms submitting a proposal under this RFP must be certified as SDVOSB by the Small Business Administration in accordance with FAR 19.1403. The NAICS Code is 493190 (Other Warehouse and Storage). The Government anticipates awarding two firm fixed-price contracts. This requirement will be for a four-year base period (April 1, 2027 to March 31, 2031), a five-year option period (April 1, 2031 to March 31, 2036), and an option to extend the contract for up to six individual months (April 1, 2036 to September 30, 2036). This procurement will be solicited under full and open competition after exclusion of sources. Interested firms may submit proposals for one location or both locations. The solicitation will be published electronically on the SAM website at https://sam.gov/. Interested companies responding to the solicitation will be required to register in the System for Award Management (SAM) and Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) prior to submitting a proposal. The Date of the Pre-Preproposal conference, in conjunction with the sites visit will be listed in the solicitation. Offerors will be required to submit in writing to the Contract Specialist (via e-mail) the name(s) and email(s) of the individual(s) who plan to attend by 11:00 AM Eastern Time on October 22, 2026.

description: 10/16/2026: Please be advised that Amendment #1 has been issued. Please refer to the attachments section to access the updated documents. __________________________________________________________________________ The U.S. General Services Administration (GSA), Public Buildings Service, Capital Projects Contracting Division, is pleased to announce the issuance of a Request for Proposals (RFP) for a project at the Thurgood Marshall U.S. Courthouse, situated at 40 Foley Square in New York, NY. This project will include scope to modernize seventeen (17) elevators, as well as upgrade mechanical, electrical and fire protection equipment within the elevator machine rooms. The Courthouse will remain fully operational throughout the duration of the project. To ensure minimal disruption to Government operations, the work must be phased to limit interruptions to operations and any disruptive work must be executed after business hours, predominately work taking place within the elevator shaftways. The selected General Contractor will be required to ensure full compliance with the Government�s requirements for access and security. Additionally, the General Contractor will be required to complete this project in accordance with the construction drawings and specifications that will be issued for this project. The selected General Contractor will be required to ensure full compliance with the Public Buildings Service Interim Core Building Standards, and the U.S. Courts Design Guide. Contract Type: The contract type for this procurement will be Firm-Fixed price. The line item schedule will include a lump sum item for the Base. There will be option line items for this procurement. Price: The total magnitude of this project at award is between $20,000,000 and $40,000,000. Selection and Schedule: This requirement will be competitively procured in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 15.1�Source Selection Processes and Techniques ((GSA Class Deviation RFO-2025-15) and FAR 36.101-2 (GSA Class Deviation RFO-2025-36)). The awardee will be competitively chosen using best value tradeoff procedures in accordance with FAR Subparts 15.1 and 15.2 (GSA Class Deviation RFO-2025-15). NAICS: This procurement will be conducted under North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code 236220--Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. The Small Business size standard is an average annual sales and receipts for the past three (3) years that are equal to or less than $45,000,000. Prospective offerors bear sole responsibility for tracking and retrieving the RFP alongside all associated amendments.

title: Bravo Dive Boat 65DS1101
description: AMENDMENT 0003 POSTED 11/26. AMENDMENT 0002 POSTED 11/21. AMENDMENT 0001 POSTED 11/19. The Regional Maintenance Center at Puget Sound Naval Shipyard & Intermediate Maintenance Facility (PSNS & IMF) intends to award a stand-alone Firm-Fixed-Price contract to accomplish the maintenance, repair, and preservation in support of one (1) 65 FT BRAVO DIVE BOAT 65DS1101. Work will be accomplished at the Contractor's facility. Geographical Area of consideration: To facilitate proper government oversight, the facility shall be located in the Puget Sound, WA region. For this procurement, the Puget Sound, WA region is defined as the West Coast of the continental US, starting from Olympia, WA and extending northward to Bellingham, WA. 65DS1101 Length: 69 FT 10 IN Width: 22 FT 0 IN Draft: 3 FT 6 IN Full Displacement: 55 L TONS Age: 13 YEARS Light Load: 8,000 lbs Hull Type: Aluminum Scope Overview: Coordinate with the Contracting Officer, via the Contracting Officer�s Representative (COR) to deliver the vessel to the Contractor�s facility from Puget Sound Naval Shipyard (PSNS) Bremerton, WA. Remove all fendering and sweep blast clean. Accomplish survey of hull to identify and repair corrosion, preserve the exterior above and below the waterline, including the crane. Apply nonskid to horizontal surfaces on the exterior and interior of the boat. Replace motor mounts. Remove, inspect and install shafting, rudders and propellers. HVAC repair. Maintain and repair watertight hatches and doors. Repair, modify and preserve push knee. Replace and modify corroded deck and bulkhead structure in the main cabin. Install remote fuel shut offs. Identify and repair corrosion beneath the transformers in the aft lazzarette, install a weather shield above the starboard transformer in the aft lazzarette. Replace hydraulic, and fuel hoses. Identify and repair corroded structure beneath the shower room drain. Remove windows, repair window heaters, and reinstall windows. Replace fire suppression system piping and recertify system. Repair damage to the port bow. Accomplish modification and repair of swim platform stairs. Restore preservation system on the console in the pilot house. Replace existing generators with supplied Kohler generators, Modify, repair and install fendering system. Modify and repair the monkey heater system. Remove, inspect, preserve and install rudders. Replace thru hull valves and flexible hoses. Replace false bulkheads in the shower room and head. Open, clean and inspect all tanks. Perform sea trials after completion of repairs and full cure time of preservation. Arrange and coordinate the delivery of the vessel back to the Government with the Contracting Officer via the COR. The Period of Performance is expected to be 25 March 2026 to 29 May 2026. This is a 100% Small Business set-aside under the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) 336611, size standard 1,300 employees. All offerors must be registered with the System for Award Management (SAM) to receive award of Government contracts. Offerors are advised also that SAM representations and certifications can be completed electronically via the System for Award Management website at https://www.sam.gov. NOTE 1: Please pay particular attention to the inclusion of DFARS 252.232-7998 Obligations in Advance of Fiscal Year 2026 Funding (DEVIATION 2026-O0001). NOTE 2: Please review Request for Quote instructions regarding contract financing.

title: C--Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) 3DNTM
description: This Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) is issued to provide an opportunity to partner with the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) and other Federal agencies to acquire high-resolution 3D elevation and hydrography mapping data through the 3DNTM Data Collaboration Announcement (DCA). The 3DNTM DCA partnerships efficiently and effectively leverage funding to respond to the documented and growing need for high-quality elevation and hydrography data, which significantly benefit Americans across an array of applications like infrastructure planning, discovery of critical minerals, energy development, and disaster preparation and response for severe weather events, earthquakes, landslides, and other emergencies. Project submissions are invited from applicants who wish to partner through the 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) opportunity or the 3D Hydrography Program (3DHP) opportunity to fund lidar or hydrography data acquisition through the USGS Geospatial Products and Services Contract (GPSC). Federal agencies, state and local governments, tribes, academic institutions, and the private sector are eligible to submit projects. The Government will review applications based on the evaluation criteria identified in section VII of this opportunity. A synopsis of previous 3DNTM DCA Awards is available on https://usgs.gov/3DNTM/DCA. 3DEP and 3DHP products and services, including data resulting from this opportunity can be accessed via The National Map Data Download and Visualization Services: https://apps.nationalmap.gov.

Le marché couvre la réalisation complète des toitures plates pour un bâtiment neuf ainsi que pour la réfection d'une partie d'un bâtiment existant. Les prestations incluent la mise en œuvre de toitures végétalisées, de toitures praticables (terrasses) et d'une section avec couverture en zinc, ainsi que le traitement d'étanchéité des pieds de façade.


Les prestations principales concernent trois types de toitures : une toiture végétalisée (558 m²) avec isolation EPS (polystyrène expansé) et étanchéité anti-racines, une terrasse praticable (102 m²) avec isolation PIR (polyisocyanurate) et dallettes, et une toiture en zinc (8 m²). S’y ajoutent le traitement des pieds de façade, le cuvelage de la fosse d’ascenseur, et la pose de ferblanterie en acier inoxydable.


En complément, le marché comprend des travaux spécifiques tels que la réalisation d'un cuvelage en résine pour la fosse d'ascenseur et la pose de tous les ouvrages de ferblanterie en acier inoxydable. Un volet sécurité important est prévu, avec l'installation d'une ligne de vie complète et d'une échelle d'accès à crinoline. L'ensemble des travaux devra être réalisé en stricte conformité avec les normes SIA et les conditions particulières du projet.

title: Acquisition de l’information statique aux voyageurs
description:
Les panneaux d’information existants aux arrêts se sont développés au fil du temps et présentent des configurations différentes ainsi qu’un degré de standardisation limité. Cette situation entraîne des charges accrues en matière d’exploitation, d’entretien et de renouvellement. Il existe en outre un potentiel d’optimisation en termes de lisibilité et d’information des voyageurs.


Les Transports publics biennois prévoient donc l’acquisition et la mise en service d’un nouveau système standardisé d’information voyageurs statique (IVS). L’objectif est de disposer d’un système répondant aux besoins de la clientèle, fonctionnel et économiquement viable, tout en garantissant une apparence uniforme des arrêts.


Dans le cadre d’un projet distinct, des affichages dynamiques d’information aux voyageurs (DIV) ont déjà été installés à certains arrêts.

TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: PBI High-Temperature Hollow Fiber Membranes
description: Polybenzimidazole (PBI) High-Temperature Hollow Fiber Membranes offer a practical way to improve separation efficiency in process environments where standard polymer membranes often lose performance or durability. The platform combines high-temperature operation, chemical resistance and compact hollow-fiber design in a membrane system that can help users recover hydrogen, separate carbon dioxide and process difficult liquid streams with lower energy demand and a smaller equipment footprint than many conventional approaches. Because the fibers are formed from a robust PBI material and engineered with an integrated thin selective layer, the technology is well suited for organizations seeking stronger performance in demanding energy, chemical and water treatment settings. How it Works The membrane works like a selective gate built into a very small hollow strand. A mixed gas or liquid flows across the fiber, and the thin outer layer allows some molecules to pass through more readily than others, while the porous support beneath it gives the fiber strength and a path for transport. The disclosed fabrication process forms that selective layer and support structure in one step, then can add heat treatment or a thin sealing layer to improve stability and sharpen separation performance. Technical Description The polybenzimidazole invention is centered on a method for making asymmetric hollow fiber membranes from polybenzimidazole, a polymer valued for strong thermal and chemical stability. A PBI dope solution and a bore fluid are extruded through a spinneret, then passed through an optional air gap and into a water coagulation bath, which forms a hollow fiber with an integrated selective layer and a porous support structure. The process can produce nearly defect-free selective layers, and the patent states that selective layer thickness can be controlled from about 0.1 to 5 �m, with examples demonstrating thicknesses down to about 160 nm and one example near 0.38 �m. A major technical advantage is control over membrane microstructure and durability. PBI High-Temperature Hollow Fiber Membranes emphasize macrovoid-free fibers, which are important because macrovoids create weak points that can fail under high temperature and pressure. The membranes can be thermally annealed or chemically crosslinked to improve solvent resistance and stability, and a defect-sealing layer can be added to improve selectivity without changing the core fiber architecture. In demonstrated gas-separation modules, the technology showed hydrogen permeance above 100 GPU, with one example reporting 242 GPU at 250 �C and hydrogen/carbon dioxide selectivity of 19.1, while long-term testing in wet syngas with 20 ppm H2S showed stable performance over 40 days. The patent also states that the membranes can operate up to about 400 �C and are suitable for gas, vapor and liquid separations including hydrogen purification, carbon capture, brine treatment and organic solvent separations. Advantages Operates at temperatures that are too demanding for many conventional polymer membranes Resists harsh chemical exposure including steam and sulfur-containing gases compact module design enables smaller equipment footprint easier scaling than ceramic membranes higher throughput without compromising permeability, selectivity or membrane area cost Combines selectivity and structural support in one integrated membrane architecture Supports both gas and liquid separation opportunities across multiple industries Reduces overall hydrogen purification costs Has already been tested in relevant operating environments rather than remaining only a laboratory concept Market Applications Energy and Power generation (hydrogen production, pre-combustion carbon capture, syngas cleanup) Oil and Gas (refining, natural gas processing, produced water treatment) Chemical and Petrochemical Processing (process gas separation, solvent dehydration, feedstream cleanup) Industrial Water and Wastewater (high-salinity brines, water purification, water and acid separation) Advanced Fuels (Fischer-Tropsch processing, fuel conversion, synthesis gas upgrading) Specialty Manufacturing (organic solvent recovery, pharmaceutical and fine chemical separations) Development Status: TRL 5 US Patent No. 10,071,345 LA-UR-26-24561 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. description: VA AIR AMBULANCE BROKER WITH SUPPORTING GROUND TRANSPORTATION VIRTUAL INDUSTRY DAY NOTICE December 10-11, 2026 Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Transportation Program (VTP) Network Contracting Office (NCO) 20 1. Purpose The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Transportation Program (VTP), will host an Industry Day to engage with air and ground transportation brokers capable of providing Air Ambulance Broker with Supporting Ground Transportation Services nationwide. This Industry Day is not a request for proposal. It is a market research tool being used to determine potential firms capable of providing the services described herein prior to determining the method of acquisition. The purpose of this session is to: Provide industry with an overview of the upcoming Air Ambulance Broker Services requirement. Offer vendors an opportunity to ask questions and provide feedback prior to release of the solicitation. Support industry�s understanding of VTP�s operational needs, compliance requirements, and contracting expectations as defined within the Performance Work Statement (PWS). 2. Requirement Overview The upcoming procurement will establish multiple-award IDIQ contracts for nationwide fixed-wing and rotary-wing air ambulance broker services, supported by ancillary ground transportation services which refers to transportation services used to transport Veterans between airports, healthcare facilities, Veterans' residences, and other approved destinations. Ground transportation modes may include private vehicles, taxis, rideshare services, wheelchair-accessible vans and shuttles, ambulances, and other specialized transportation services necessary to meet a Veteran's mobility, accessibility, or medical transportation needs. Key highlights include: 24/7/365 availability including holidays Compliance with CAMTS/NAAMTA transport standards Real-time communication and documentation via VA Mandated Transportation Software Quality Control and subcontractor oversight requirements Support for advanced life support, life support, basic life support, critical care transport and stretcher transports 3. The Request for Proposal The Request for Proposal number is 36C26027R0012. The solicitation will result in the award of three (3) to five (5) firm fixed-price MATOCs. The applicable NAICS code is 481211, Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation with a small business size standard of 1,500 employees. 4. Industry Day will be held virtually, on Microsoft Teams, on December 10 � 11, 2026. A hybrid format for this Industry Day is anticipated: December 10, 2026 Morning Session: General overview for all prospective offerors Afternoon Sessions: Optional one-on-one discussions with individual vendors (NTE 50 minutes) December 11, 2026 All Day: Optional one-on-one discussions with individual vendors (NTE 50 minutes hour) Please note that all times for the scheduled sessions will be stated in Pacific Standard Time (PST) 5. Points of Contact (POCs) Contracting (NCO 20): Primary: Wendy Duval @ wendy.duval@va.gov Alternates: Michael Allred @ michael.allred1@va.gov Program Office (VTP): Primary: Tony Guagliardo Alternate: Mindy LaCrone 6. Tentative Agenda Welcome & Introductions Overview of VTP Mission and Needs Air Ambulance PWS Requirements Review Acquisition Strategy & Timeline Vendor Q&A One-on-one Sessions with Interested Offerors 7. Additional Notices This Industry Day is informational only and does not constitute a solicitation or request for proposals. Draft documentation, including the PWS and/or the RFP, may be provided for industry review prior to or during the session. 8. Significant subcontractors may also participate. title: TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: SurfGraphPro
description: SurfGraphPro, an AI tool, transforms complex protein structures into an easy-to-analyze format that helps researchers quickly identify binding sites, predict molecular interactions and understand protein behavior with greater speed and scalability than traditional approaches. By combining 3D surface graph representations with advanced machine learning, this technology from Los Alamos National Laboratory reduces the computational burden of protein analysis while preserving the structural detail needed for high-value applications in drug discovery, antibody design, pathogen detection and custom protein engineering. The Challenge: Protein surfaces are extremely complex, three-dimensional structures, and that complexity makes them difficult to analyze using traditional computational approaches. In practice, many existing methods rely on hand-selected biochemical features, expensive calculations or narrow task-specific models that do not generalize well to new questions. As a result, researchers can face slow runtimes, limited scalability and incomplete insight when trying to identify binding sites, predict molecular interactions or understand broader protein behavior across large sets of proteins. These limitations can make it difficult to move quickly from protein structure data to useful predictions in areas such as drug discovery, antibody design, pathogen detection and protein engineering. Problems Solved: SurfGraphPro solves these problems by converting protein surfaces into a graph-based representation that preserves both the physical shape of the surface and the biochemical information carried by surface-exposed amino acids. This tool gives machine learning models a more efficient and flexible way to process protein structures without requiring repeated manual feature engineering or highly specialized analysis pipelines for each new use case. By reducing computational burden while keeping the key structural details needed for prediction, SurfGraphPro makes it possible to analyze proteins more quickly, at larger scale and across a wider range of applications. This approach includes identifying likely binding sites, estimating molecular compatibility, supporting drug screening efforts, improving antibody and protein design workflows, and enabling other protein-focused prediction tasks where speed, scalability and adaptability matter. Key Advantages: Helps turn complex protein structures into information computers can use more easily Speeds up protein analysis compared with older approaches Reduces the amount of manual feature engineering needed Preserves important details about both protein shape and chemical properties Supports multiple uses, including drug discovery, antibody design and pathogen detection Offers a flexible platform that can be adapted to different protein-related tasks Market Applications: Pharmaceuticals and Biotechnology (drug discovery, target screening, protein optimization) Biologics and Antibody Development (antibody engineering, binding analysis, therapeutic design) Diagnostics and Infectious Disease (pathogen detection, biomarker analysis, assay development) Agricultural Biotechnology (protein analysis, crop trait research, bio-based product development) Materials and Industrial Science (protein-mineral interaction studies, polymer compatibility, bio-inspired materials) Research Tools and Software (protein modeling, computational biology, prediction platforms) Development Status: TRL 3 US Patent pending LA-UR-26-23589 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. LANL�s licensing program focuses on moving inventions developed by our researchers to commercial innovations. Patented and patent pending inventions and copyrighted software are available to existing and start-up companies through exclusive and non-exclusive licensing agreements. For specific discussions, please contact licensing@lanl.gov. Note: This is not a call for external services for the development of this technology. https://www.lanl.gov/engage/collaboration/feynman-center/partner-with-us/licensing-technology m.lanl.gov/tech-search

description:
La rocade de Sissach a été mise en service en 2006.


Le tunnel de Chienberg, long de 2 294 mètres, constitue l'élément central de la rocade. Il se compose de deux tronçons construits à ciel ouvert, d'un tronçon réalisé selon la méthode de construction par voûte et d'un tronçon creusé selon la méthode minière.


Compte tenu de son état actuel, le tunnel du Chienberg doit faire l’objet d’une rénovation complète après environ 25 ans d’exploitation. Dans ce cadre, il convient également de mettre en œuvre les mesures de rénovation conformes aux normes pour tous les ouvrages d’art situés dans le périmètre du projet ou dans la zone de la rocade de Sissach, ainsi que pour les éléments du tracé. Il est prévu de réaliser les mesures d’entretien nécessaires, tant au niveau des travaux de construction que de la sécurité et de la protection civile, dans le cadre de la rénovation complète au cours des années 2032, 2033 et 2034.
